subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` expose metadata for transcript-mentioned files outside the workspace root or fs-safe-rejected paths?
rationale: The PR changes a security-sensitive read boundary, and the safe product behavior could be filtering external entries, showing a neutral external status, or deliberately exposing metadata with explicit approval.

options.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve the badge with boundary-preserving filtering or external-status semantics plus regression tests.

options.title: Accept External Metadata
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external metadata only with maintainer/security signoff, protocol/UI tests, and clear product semantics for directories and symlinks.

options.title: Split UI From Backend
options.body: Land or keep a narrow layout-only change separately and leave external-file semantics to the linked workspace panel issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve the badge with boundary-preserving filtering or external-status semantics plus regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace file preview and read-only workspace browsing hardening makes this the closest current owner for the security-boundary decision.
